### Regions Financial to Participate in BancAnalysts Association of Boston Conference


Oct 6, 2026


*Live webcast will be accessible on Regions’ Investor Relations website.*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Regions Financial Corp.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54616429&newsitemid=20261006143354&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Financial+Corp.&index=1&md5=e4cc38566114fc505396ed7380228d3d) (NYSE:RF) on Tuesday announced company executives will participate in the upcoming BancAnalysts Association of Boston (BAAB) Conference.


Regions’ portion of the conference will begin at approximately 8:45 a.m. ET on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. Executives from the bank will take part in a fireside chat-style discussion with the conference moderator. The discussion can be live-streamed in a listen-only format by visiting Regions’ Investor Relations site at[ir.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com&esheet=54616429&newsitemid=20261006143354&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.regions.com&index=2&md5=ce130caeeedfe8c1658098c9b4b90cc5) during the event.


A replay will also be made available on the Investor Relations page following the event.


**About Regions Financial Corporation**


Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $161 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54616429&newsitemid=20261006143354&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=3&md5=5892d65e4579167217534e6992be4893) .
